jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Buyers Products Company, a leading manufacturer in the work truck industry, is seeking an experienced Engineering Director to join our team. In this role, you will provide strategic and operational leadership for Product Engineering, Sustaining/Manufacturing Engineering, and Fixture Design Engineering while driving innovation, manufacturing excellence, and continuous improvement across the organization. You will play a key role in developing engineering talent, advancing new product development, and ensuring alignment between engineering execution and business objectives.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineering leader with deep manufacturing expertise, a passion for developing high-performing teams, and a proven ability to drive results in a fast-paced environment. If you enjoy leading cross-functional initiatives, solving complex technical challenges, and influencing the future direction of products and manufacturing processes, we'd like to hear from you.

What You Will Do

Lead, manage, and develop Product, Sustaining/Manufacturing, and Fixture Design Engineering teams.
Set clear priorities and execution cadence aligned with business objectives.
Build team capability, develop leaders, and drive accountability for results.
Maintain a visible, hands-on presence on the manufacturing floor.
Lead engineering ownership from concept through production and growth including Design for Manufacturability (DFM), and validation.
Oversee design, analysis, testing, and release in compliance with quality and regulatory standards.
Drive cost reduction through design without compromising quality or performance.
Establish and maintain engineering standards and best practices.
Partner with manufacturing and Continuous Improvement to support lean initiatives, solve problems, and drive continuous improvement.
Improve welding, forming, and assembly performance through design, process capability, and tooling innovation.
Work with manufacturing engineering to improve automation and apply best practices to improve quality, throughput, and repeatability.
Directly lead the Fixture Design Engineering team, with full responsibility for performance and output.
Own fixture and tooling strategy, capacity planning, and technical standards.
Deliver solutions that enable automation and ensure safe, consistent, and repeatable builds.
Partner with Product Management, Sales, Operations, Customer Service, Continuous Improvement, Quality, and Sourcing to execute business objectives.
Support supplier qualification, make/buy decisions, and cost management.
Establish and govern product change and release processes, documentation, and configuration management.
Maintain engineering data within ERP/document control systems and develop product cost estimates.
Support intellectual property efforts and provide technical expertise for complex customer and legal matters.
Other duties as assigned.

Skills & Experience

15+ years of progressive engineering experience, including leadership of multiple teams in manufacturing.
Experience leading through managers/technical leads in a scaled engineering organization.
Strong technical depth with ability to lead through influence and make data-driven decisions.
Proven lean manufacturing experience, including continuous improvement and shop floor problem solving.
Experience leading fixture/tooling engineering to enable automation (e.g., robotic welding, automated assembly).
Fluency with CAD, ERP systems, and document control practices.
ERP experience including BOM structure, part creation, and engineering standardization.
Portfolio management experience including prioritization, capacity planning, and risk management across multiple programs.
Ability to influence across executive, plant, and cross-functional stakeholders.
Strong communication, analytical, and organizational skills with a high sense of urgency and ownership.
Hands-on leadership style with strong accountability for execution and results.
Consumer products or industrial manufacturing experience preferred.
Regulatory compliance experience is a plus (e.g., Prop 65, Conflict Minerals, REACH, RoHS).

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field required.

Physical Requirements and Work Environment

Regular presence on manufacturing and distribution floors, including extended walking in large-scale facilities.
Exposure to industrial equipment, machinery, and active production environments.
Periods of stationary, computer-based work in an office setting.

What We Offer

We believe in rewarding our employees for their hard work and commitment. As part of the Buyers Products team, you'll enjoy:
Competitive pay
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits
Generous vacation and paid time off (PTO)
Profit-sharing opportunities
Career growth and advancement potential
Additional employee programs, perks, and benefits

About Buyers Products Company

Established in 1946, Buyers Products Company is a premier manufacturer serving the work truck industry. Our products include durable truck boxes, heavy-duty towing equipment, hydraulics, controls, and trailer accessories. Our snow and ice equipment brands include SnowDogg® snowplows, SaltDogg® spreaders, and ScoopDogg® snow pushers.
Join a company with a long history of innovation, quality, and growth while building a rewarding career.

jobs.description:
Position Summary:

100% on-site

Greendale is one of two gummy technology development and manufacturing facilities in North America. The site has the capability to manufacture traditional gelatin gummies as well as 100% plant-based pectin gummies for nutritional supplements and nutraceuticals. With extensive development and manufacturing expertise and a wide range of flavors, shapes, sizes, and colors available, we can work with complex ingredients to help create engaging new products consumers will love.

The Director, Engineering will provide strategic leadership and oversight for all site engineering functions, including maintenance, facilities, utilities, capital projects, packaging engineering, and process engineering. This role is responsible for ensuring reliable, compliant, and efficient operations across manufacturing and packaging through disciplined asset management, engineering excellence, and execution of both minor and major capital projects.

The Director will lead, develop, and coach a multi-disciplinary engineering organization to deliver maximum asset reliability, operational performance, and continuous improvement. Own the Site Master Plan, and capital strategy to align infrastructure, technology, and capacity with current and future business needs. Accountable for ensuring all engineering, maintenance, and facilities activities fully comply with site, corporate, and regulatory requirements, including cGMP, safety, and environmental standards, while supporting audit readiness and inspection success.

The Role:

Provide direct and indirect leadership to maintenance and facilities teams, ensuring safe, compliant, and efficient execution of all activities.
Oversee facilities, utilities, and infrastructure to ensure operational readiness, environmental compliance, regulatory adherence, and long-term facility integrity.
Lead Process Engineering to improve manufacturing robustness, yield, and throughput through data-driven process optimization and problem solving.
Lead Packaging Engineering to ensure packaging line performance, technical transfer, equipment capability, and continuous improvement of packaging operations.
Own and execute the capital project portfolio, including both minor and major engineering projects from concept through commissioning, qualification, and validation.
Prioritize and manage capital allocation to maximize ROI, capacity expansion, compliance, and operational efficiency.
Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineering leaders, engineers, and technicians; build organizational capability and technical depth while continuously assessing talent, building bench strength, and ensuring succession readiness across critical roles in a complex, fast-paced environment.
Own engineering performance metrics, including asset reliability, OEE, project execution, and compliance indicators, and lead disciplined execution against CAPEX and R&M budgets to deliver both short- and long-term business outcomes.
Contribute as a key member of the site leadership team, shaping site strategy, operational priorities, and resource allocation to enable delivery of business objectives in a complex, dynamic environment.
Drive proactive identification and mitigation of compliance risks related to equipment, utilities, facilities, and engineering processes.
Other duties as assigned.

The Candidate:

Bachelor’s degree in engineering; advanced degree (MS or MBA) preferred MBA a plus.
10+ years engineering, continuous improvement, manufacturing technology, validation.
5+ years management experience and in a regulated industry.
Strong analytical/problem solving/process improvement skills. Certified Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt preferred.  
Knowledge/Skills Requirements: Combustible Dust and Wastewater Management experience preferred.
Understanding of mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, and utility systems.
Strong leadership skills, with an ability to partner, build trust, provide direction, and execute with excellence. Ability to prioritize and follow-through to achieve results and meet deadlines.
Strong foundation interpersonal communication concepts, specifically, written, oral, presentation, listening, and facilitation skills. Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.
OSHA 10 or equivalent training.
Demonstrable leadership experience at Catalent (including but not limited to participation in Catalent-sponsored leadership programs such as NGGL, GOLD, LEAD Now, GM Excellence, and GROW) may be considered in place of external experience.

Potential for career growth on an expanding team

jobs.description:

Tract is a team of digital infrastructure experts dedicated to accelerating responsible data center growth by developing master-planned data center parks with access to pre-positioned power and fiber in key markets where hyperscale and AI demand is going. Our approach is collaborative with governments, utilities, cities, and regions to ensure development is targeted for the optimal locations to maximize the economic development benefits for the community while being good stewards of the land and minimizing the impact on neighbors. Tract is headquartered in Denver, Colorado, with real estate holdings throughout the United States.

The VP of Network Operations Engineering oversees the day-to-day operations of the network investments, translating corporate strategy into actionable plans, managing budgets, and ensuring alignment with long-term goals. This role is hands-on, requiring strategic vision, operational execution, and engineering skills.

Job Responsibilities

The successful candidate will be responsible for the following key areas:

Strategic Leadership

Partner with executives to cascade corporate goals and develop operational strategies that support network business objectives

Budget & Resource Management

Optimize CAPEX and OPEX budgets related to conduit and fiber, manage operational policies, and allocate resources effectively

Network Team Development

Mentor and lead a high-performing operations/engineering teams, fostering accountability, leadership succession planning, and a culture of continuous improvement

Network Reliability

Oversee the tactical health of the physical OSP network topology, prioritizing installations, preventative maintenance, and rapid network repair

Project & Risk Management

Guide teams using project management tools to deliver milestones safely, on time, and within budget

Compliance & Safety

Enforce rigorous health, safety, and 811 regulations, embedding a proactive safety culture and tracking QA workflows and KPIs

Procurement & Partnerships

Manage relationships with vendors, partners, and municipal authorities, securing rights-of-way and permits

Process Improvement

Implement operational/engineering best practices to enhance productivity, reduce costs, and improve service delivery

Strategic Planning and Execution

Develop and implement business development strategies, plans, and processes to achieve growth targets, expand market share, and increase revenue

Network Design and Engineering

Develop detailed OSP network designs, including fiber routes, conduit systems, pole attachments, handholes, cabinets, and other supporting infrastructure
Perform site surveys and field validation to ensure design accuracy and identify potential challenges
Utilize design software such as GIS and CAD to prepare construction drawings, splicing schematics, and as-built documentation
Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations, as well as industry standards

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Project Management, Telecommunications, Engineering or related degree.
10+ years of progressive leadership in telecom/broadband, OSP engineering, and fiber construction.
In lieu of degree, 15+ years of progressive leadership in telecom/broadband, OSP engineering and fiber construction.
5+ years vendor management experience
5+ years managing budgets of (25MM-100MM)
5+ years building and managing teams of 5-10
Expertise in fiber optic networks, splicing, testing, and construction standards
Proficiency with project management software and GIS systems
Strong leadership, analytical & problem solving abilities to make critical decisions with little input from others
Self-motivated, low-ego leader with high emotional intelligence, transparency, and respect for teams and partners

Preferred Qualifications

Start-up experience
Experience with 3 GIS and/or ESRI

Travel Requirement:
25%

Expected Salary Range:
[$175,000 - $250,000] Base Salary + Discretionary Bonus

Tract employees enjoy competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, including 100% employer-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401K program, standard paid holidays, and unlimited PTO.

jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

From strategy to execution, the Government & Public Sector (GPS) practice of Ernst & Young LLP provides a full range of consulting and audit services to help our Federal, State, Local and Education clients implement new ideas to help achieve their mission outcomes. We deliver real change and measurable results through our diverse, high-performing teams, quality work at the highest professional standards, operational know-how from across our global organization, and creative and bold ideas that drive innovation. We enable our government clients to achieve their mission of protecting the nation and serving the people; increasing public safety; improving healthcare for our military, veterans and citizens; delivering essential public services; and helping those in need. EY is ready to help our government build a better working world.

Our GPS Technology Organization is a structure within the US GPS practice that implements and maintains a new operate and technology model designed specifically to support U.S. defense and Government engagements.

The opportunity

This role supports large, complex government cloud programs within Azure Government environments and is accountable for the successful delivery of platform and infrastructure capabilities at scale. The Assistant Director owns outcomes across multiple workstreams, translating business and mission needs into secure, scalable, and sustainable cloud platforms. The role operates at the intersection of strategy and execution, guiding technical direction, enabling delivery teams, and influencing stakeholders across product, engineering, and platform organizations. In addition to hands on technical leadership, the role is responsible for developing team capability, driving continuous improvement, and making informed trade offs to balance delivery, quality, risk, and long term platform health within government and security constrained environments

Your Key Responsibilities

Own the delivery of cloud platform and infrastructure capabilities across multiple initiatives, ensuring alignment with business, mission, and security requirements
Set and guide technical direction for Azure Government platforms, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and operationally sustainable
Establish and evolve DevSecOps practices and automation approaches to improve delivery consistency, quality, and reliability
Make informed technical and delivery trade off decisions, balancing speed, quality, security, risk, and long term platform health
Lead architecture and design efforts, reviewing and approving solutions to ensure alignment with standards, constraints, and desired outcomes
Oversee risk, dependency, and issue management across delivery efforts, escalating and resolving proactively as needed
Influence stakeholders across product, engineering, and leadership teams to align priorities and drive execution without direct authority
Develop and grow engineering talent through coaching, feedback, and delegation, strengthening overall team capability
Promote operational excellence by continuously improving processes, tooling, and ways of working

Skills And Attributes For Success

Demonstrates accountability for outcomes, taking ownership of decisions and following through to execution
Applies sound judgment when operating in ambiguity, making trade offs that consider delivery impact, risk, and long term sustainability
Influences outcomes across teams and stakeholders through credibility, collaboration, and clear communication
Communicates complex technical and delivery topics effectively to technical, business, and executive audiences
Adapts approach as priorities, constraints, and requirements evolve while maintaining delivery momentum
Develops people and teams by providing clear direction, timely feedback, and opportunities for growth
Promotes a culture of quality, risk awareness, and continuous improvement
Demonstrates curiosity and continuous learning, staying current with evolving technologies, delivery practices, and firm direction

To qualify for the role, you must have

7+ years in engineering roles working with private/public cloud IaaS, PaaS, and/or SaaS
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent experience
Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) and Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
Strong hands-on experience:
Infrastructure as Code & CI/CD – designing and delivering with tools such as Bicep, Azure DevOps, ARM templates, or Ansible
Containers and orchestration – experience building and running containerized workloads using technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Container Apps, or Helm for packaging and deploying services at scale
Networking fundamentals – strong foundation designing and troubleshooting VNets, subnets, network security groups (NSGs), routing (UDRs), and basic load-balancing scenarios, with enough depth to reason about hub-and-spoke or similar topologies and diagnose common connectivity issues
Cloud security principles – solid understanding of concepts such as shared responsibility, least privilege, identity-driven security, network segmentation, encryption, and logging/monitoring, and how to apply them for customers driven by regulatory compliance requirements, such as: NIST, FedRAMP
Identity and access – understanding of Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, Entra ID RBAC, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and managed identities for Azure resources
Windows and Linux administration – hands-on experience managing, troubleshooting, and hardening server workloads, including patching, performance tuning, and applying security baselines (e.g., DISA STIG or equivalent)
Scripting / programming – practical automation experience using PowerShell (Python or similar scripting languages is a plus but not required
Experience with government security frameworks (e.g., NIST controls)
Hands-on delivery in Agile environments (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or similar)
Strong written and verbal communication and the ability to work effectively on distributed teams

Ideally, you’ll also have

Ability to obtain and maintain Top-Secret Security Clearance
Deeper hands-on experience with:
Git-based source control and branching strategies
AWS/GCP cloud experience / knowledge
Azure DevOps Pipelines and broader Azure platform services
Ansible and Bicep for advanced automation and configuration
Azure Policy and multi-tenant / multi-subscription design patterns
Advanced Azure networking experience – hands-on exposure to one or more of: VPN Gateway or ExpressRoute, Azure Firewall or other NVAs, Virtual WAN hubs, Application Gateway or similar L7 gateways, and more complex hybrid or multi-region network designs

Additional relevant certifications, such as:
AZ-400, AZ-500, AZ-700
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or CKAD / CKNS
Red Hat Certified Specialist in Ansible Automation

What We Look For

A self-starter, independent-thinker, curious and creative person with ambition and passion
History of continuous learning and continuous progression

What We Offer You

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $111,100 to $207,800. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $133,300 to $236,100. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

The Senior Director, Infrastructure & Technology Services owns the technology backbone that every function within the organization depends on: cloud, network, data center, end user computing, and hardware, together with the service management and help desk experience through which employees interact with technology every day.

Reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer, this role carries end-to-end accountability for infrastructure reliability, security posture, and service quality across the enterprise. It sits at the intersection of “keeping the lights on” and modernizing how the organization runs technology, balancing the discipline of always-on operations with a forward-looking roadmap for cloud maturity, workplace technology, and service excellence.

This is a hands-on operating leadership role. The person in this seat is accountable not just for uptime and tickets closed, but for the day-to-day experience of every employee and customer-facing system that depends on the organization's technology environment, including field locations, distribution centers, corporate offices, and digital platforms alike.

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure Strategy & Architecture.
Own the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for the organization's cloud, network, and data center infrastructure. Ensure infrastructure decisions scale with the business, support the broader technology stack, and are built for resilience, security, and cost efficiency.
Cloud & Network Operations.
Lead the teams responsible for cloud infrastructure operations, network engineering, and data center management, ensuring high availability across corporate, retail, and distribution environments.
End User Computing & Hardware.
Oversee the full lifecycle of end user computing and hardware, including procurement, deployment, refresh cycles, and support, across corporate offices, field locations, and distribution centers, ensuring employees have reliable, well-managed technology.
IT Service Management & Help Desk.
Own the service management function and help desk/service desk operations, including incident, problem, and change management. Drive a service culture defined by responsiveness, accountability, and continuous improvement in employee and customer experience.
Reliability, Resilience & Security.
Ensure infrastructure and end user environments meet enterprise standards for uptime, disaster recovery, business continuity, and patch/vulnerability management, in close partnership with Security and Risk teams.
Vendor & Cost Management.
Manage infrastructure, hardware, telecom, and cloud vendor relationships and spend, driving transparency and value in technology investment decisions in partnership with Finance.
Executive Partnership & Governance.
Act as a trusted advisor to the CTO and senior technology and business leaders, translating infrastructure performance, risk, and investment needs into clear executive-ready updates and decisions.
Team Leadership & Capability Building.
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing infrastructure and service management organization. Establish clear roles, career paths, and a culture of ownership, craftsmanship, and continuous improvement.

What Success Looks Like

Infrastructure is stable, secure, and scales ahead of business need rather than reacting to it
Employees and field location experience fast, reliable technology support with minimal friction
Service management practices are mature, measurable, and consistently meet SLA commitments
Infrastructure and hardware spend is transparent, well-managed, and aligned to business priorities
The infrastructure organization is viewed as a trusted, responsive partner, not a bottleneck

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred
10+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure, cloud operations, IT service management, or technology operations leadership roles
Demonstrated ownership of enterprise cloud (Azure preferred), network, data center, and end user computing environments

Experience supporting distributed environments, including retail field locations, distribution centers, and corporate offices, strongly preferred

Exceptional executive presence, communication, and stakeholder management skills
Experience with Retail technology environments strongly preferred

Operationally rigorous, with a strong bias for reliability and follow-through
Service-minded: treats every employee and store as a customer of the infrastructure organization

Chalk is building the data platform that powers the future of machine learning applications. We tear down complexity, latency, and scale barriers that have traditionally constrained ML capabilities. Our platform combines Rust-speed performance with elegant tools that developers love to use. Leading companies depend on Chalk for everything from stopping fraudulent credit card swipes, verifying identities, and maximizing clean energy capture. We've recently raised a $50 million Series A, led by Felicis.

Working directly with our founders, you'll serve as the engineering site lead for our New York office. You'll start by directly managing individual contributor engineers and tech leads, and as we scale the team, you'll hire and develop engineering managers beneath you — building the leadership layer of our NYC organization from the ground up.

This is a rare opportunity to define the technical strategy, organizational structure, and engineering culture of a fast-growing AI infrastructure startup. You'll collaborate with brilliant folks, including Putnam and Advent of Code winners, former Jane Street quants, and Rust compiler contributors — all dedicated to bending the curve of what's possible in AI inference.

We're in the office 5 days a week. When unavoidable conflicts come up, we’re flexible. This is not a hybrid role.

What You Will Do

Serve as the engineering site lead for New York, with ownership of all NYC engineering
Directly manage engineers building Chalk's data platform, and hire and grow engineering managers as the site scales
Partner with the founding team to set technical strategy and shape our long-term product and platform roadmap
Design the organizational structure, hiring plan, and leadership pipeline for a rapidly growing engineering site
Establish engineering processes and operating rhythms that enable high velocity without sacrificing quality
Work directly with customers and executives to understand requirements and ensure Chalk's platform solves real-world ML challenges
Define and champion Chalk's engineering culture in New York — you'll set the bar for how we attract, develop, and retain top talent

What We're Looking For

10+ years of engineering experience with 5+ years of engineering management
Experience managing managers, or a clear readiness to build and lead a multi-layer organization
Previous experience at an early-stage startup
Experience building production ML systems or data infrastructure
Strong programming skills and systems thinking — you understand how things work under the hood, and you stay close to the technology
Proven ability to lead through others: hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers and engineering leaders
Executive-level communicator who can bridge technical, business, and customer contexts
Track record of delivering complex, high-stakes projects and scaling teams through rapid growth
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent

Experience as a site lead or founding leader of a new office or engineering hub
Experience with Rust or distributed systems
